title: Pamphlet: Abolish the State, Organize the Workers (Syndicalist)
excerpt: A foundational syndicalist pamphlet from 1921 outlining the principles of direct worker action and general strikes as the means to overthrow capitalism. It features a section advocating for worker control of industrial production through decentralized councils. The total print run was listed as 5,000 copies, distributed primarily in Rotterdam and Amsterdam.
full_text: The State is merely the executive committee of the ruling class. True freedom will only come when the workers, organized in their unions, seize the factories and lands directly. Abolish the State! Organize the Workers! (Printed by the NAS union, 1921).
creator: National Arbeids Secretariaat (NAS)
